instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Rosa Delgado. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Rosa Delgado. Do not return images or details of anyone.

Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Nanny/Rosa timesheet Nov 2-8.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 2026-11-09 12:00 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door and Garage Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Rosa Delgado and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded, and say whether the list was cut at the limit. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

said:

Bill: Nanny/Rosa timesheet Nov 2-8.pdf. Cameras: Front Door and Garage Door (both entrances; Nursery is not an entrance and was left out). No sightings of Rosa at Garage Door in this period. Tolerance: 10 min, no agreed terms.

| Mon 2026-11-02 | 15:00–18:30 (3 h 30 min) | 15:03–18:34 (3 h 31 min) | 1 min | Confirmed | 2 events |
| Tue 2026-11-03 | 15:00–19:00 (4 h 00 min) | 15:00–20:15 (5 h 15 min) | seen 75 min longer than billed | Seen more than billed | 3 events; last seen 75 min after billed end |

The two Monday shifts are two rows on the same date.

**Totals**
- Billed: 13 h 30 min over 4 visits ($297.00 on the bill).
- Confirmed: 9 h 30 min over 3 visits.
- Billed more than seen: 0 h 00 min over 0 visits.
- Seen more than billed: 1 h 15 min over 1 visit, plus 2 sightings on Sat 2026-11-07 that were not billed (single sightings, so no minutes).
- Not seen while the cameras recognised other people: 0 visits.
- Inconclusive: 0 visits.
- At the printed rates ($22/h): billed more than seen $0.00; seen more than billed $27.50 (75 min).

**Bill arithmetic:** all four lines and the $297.00 total check out.

**What this means:** Three of the four billed visits match the entry cameras within 10 minutes, including both Monday shifts. On Tue 2026-11-03 the cameras recorded Rosa 75 min longer than billed, with the last sighting at 20:15 against a billed end of 19:00. Two sightings on Sat 2026-11-07 have no bill line. Camera times show passages through the entry, not the work done between them. It is worth going through these differences with Rosa, starting with the time seen but not billed.

Would you like snapshots for the rows that are not Confirmed and have sightings (Tue 2026-11-03 and Sat 2026-11-07)? And would you like this report saved on the NAS? If yes, tell me the folder.
